shots.comment: Shot 1 - the foul. Wide establishing shot down the lane.
shots.prompt: Wide shot down a dim, retro late-1970s American bowling alley lane toward the pins, seen from behind the foul line. A wiry man in his fifties with a thin mustache and a pastel-blue short-sleeve bowling shirt strides forward in a smooth bowling approach, releases the ball down the lane, and his sliding foot skids well past the foul line onto the polished lane wood as he follows through. Warm sodium overhead lighting, waxed hardwood floor reflections, hazy cigarette-smoke atmosphere, handheld 16mm film grain, late-1970s cinematography.

shots.comment: Shot 2 - Walter reacts and rises. Chained continuation into standing + drawing the gun for a longer, escalating beat.
shots.prompt: Medium shot at a scuffed orange plastic bowling-alley scorers' table. A heavyset man in his forties with a thick horseshoe mustache, aviator sunglasses, a green bowling shirt, and a tan safari vest sits beside a shaggy-haired man in a rumpled cardigan sweater and bermuda shorts. The heavyset man's easy expression suddenly hardens, eyes narrowing, jaw clenching, as he watches something off-camera down the lane. He plants his hands on the table and begins pushing himself up out of his chair. Warm sodium overhead lighting, waxed hardwood floor reflections, hazy cigarette-smoke atmosphere, handheld 16mm film grain, late-1970s cinematography.
continue: The same heavyset man in his forties with a thick horseshoe mustache, aviator sunglasses, green bowling shirt, and tan safari vest rises fully to his feet at the scorers' table, chest heaving, and reaches into the vest to draw out a chrome revolver, leveling it out in front of him toward the lane. The shaggy-haired man beside him recoils, eyes widening in alarm. Warm sodium overhead lighting, waxed hardwood floor reflections, hazy cigarette-smoke atmosphere, handheld 16mm film grain, late-1970s cinematography.

shots.comment: Shot 3 - close-up on Walter, gun raised, shouting. Rewritten after retry 1: original prompt produced an unrelated shirtless man with no gun -- moved wardrobe/gun to the front of the sentence and dropped body-focused phrasing that was pulling the model off-identity.
shots.prompt: Tight chest-up close-up, slight low angle, of a heavyset man in his forties wearing a green bowling shirt, a tan safari vest, and aviator sunglasses, with a thick horseshoe mustache. Both his hands grip a chrome revolver held up at eye level, aimed across the bowling lane. He shouts furiously, mouth open, jaw clenched, brow furrowed in anger. Warm sodium overhead lighting, shallow depth of field, hazy cigarette-smoke atmosphere, handheld 16mm film grain, late-1970s cinematography.

shots.comment: Shot 4 - the Dude tries to defuse, hands raised. Rewritten after retry 1: original prompt (two-shot, mention of 'the gun') produced the Dude grabbing at a rifle instead of a calming gesture -- simplified to a single-character medium shot and dropped the weapon reference.
shots.prompt: Medium shot, side-on, of a shaggy-haired man in his forties with sunglasses pushed up into his messy hair, wearing a loose beige cardigan sweater over a t-shirt and bermuda shorts, standing beside an orange bowling-alley scorers' table. Close-up on a stocky balding man in his forties with a light mustache, wearing a plain maroon bowling shirt, seated at the scorers' table holding a marbled bowling ball in his lap, eyebrows raised and mouth slightly agape in complete bewilderment, glancing back and forth between people off-camera, utterly lost. shots.comment: Shot 6 - wide standoff resolution. The foul-line bowler backs off, gun still raised, other players frozen.
